notes:
The app picks up where you left off.

Webtoons always reopened at the very top, however far into the chapter you had scrolled. A webtoon chapter is one enormously tall page, so knowing "which page" was never enough to know where you were — and nothing was writing down the scroll position at all.

Now it remembers, and puts you back: the right image, and the right distance into it.

Tapping the chapter you were last reading resumes it. Tapping any other chapter still starts that one from the beginning, which is what picking a different chapter should mean.

Your position is carried in backups too, so a restored phone opens to the same place.

Also in this release, from the previous update: characters speaking from dark balloons now sound like characters instead of the narrator.
